original_benchmark.notes: 4 Lite tasks: Kirby, Pokemon Crystal, Super Mario Land and Links Awakening. These are the released Game Boy games with checkpoint images (three test games plus Mario from dev). Five other Game Boy configs lack checkpoints. DOS games, secret games, real-time mode and extra non-benchmark configs are excluded.
